The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8086` (see `InfluxDbBuilder.InfluxDbPort`)
- Environment variable: `DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_MODE=setup`
- Environment variable: `DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_USERNAME=username` (see `InfluxDbBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_PASSWORD=password` (see `InfluxDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_ORG=organization` (see `InfluxDbBuilder.WithOrganization(string)`)
- Environment variable: `DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_BUCKET=bucket` (see `InfluxDbBuilder.WithBucket(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /ping` to port `8086` is completed successfully.
